content.short: aiSports' CryptoDFS is a blockchain-based daily fantasy sports platform where you draft lineups and compete in contests for crypto rewards.
content.description: aiSports' CryptoDFS is a blockchain-based daily fantasy sports game. Build a lineup within a real-world salary cap, enter the day's contests, and win crypto rewards. Your drafted players accumulate points based on their real-game statistics, and the contract automatically distributes winnings to the team owners after NBA games conclude. CryptoDFS currently supports only the NBA, with the broader goal of becoming the web3 DFS provider for all major sports.
